subject: proof-backed static test attribution
statement: Precise graphs mark interface calls exact only when the receiver has one proven concrete dynamic type; one visible implementation is not proof. Open interface and parser paths remain possible and uncertainty propagates through transitive tests and untested. CLI tests --transitive and MCP gograph_tests share gograph.tests.v1; direct tests stays compatible. Untested returns stable IDs and does not treat ambiguous parser names as exact.

evidence.scope: Implementation and tests for dispatch, reverse attribution, ambiguity, and CLI/MCP parity
